Now I have a clear picture. The issue is in `src/transformers/tokenization_utils_base.py` at line ~2225-2227. The warning `"max_length is ignored when padding=True"` is raised unconditionally when `padding=True` and `max_length` is set, but this is misleading because `max_length` IS still used for truncation when `truncation=True` is also passed. The warning should only be issued when `max_length` is truly ignored for everything (i.e., when truncation is not also enabled).

The fix is a single condition change: add `and truncation is False` to the warning condition.
